metadata.display_name: Happy Horse by Ace Data Cloud
metadata.short_desc: Happy Horse text/image video generation and same-task retrieval through Ace Data Cloud.
metadata.desc: Happy Horse text/image video generation and same-task retrieval through Ace Data Cloud. Configure your own Ace API key. /happyhorse_ace shows help; administrators use /happyhorse_ace_task for an existing task. This integration is provided by Ace Data Cloud.

api_key.description: Ace Data Cloud API Key for Happy Horse
api_key.hint: Copy/create a dedicated key in Ace Applications → General application → Manage Keys. Allow /happyhorse/videos and /happyhorse/tasks. No Bearer prefix; never paste into chat. Masking does not encrypt the data directory.
